cards.name: Hermes Agent
cards.hint: Managed by docker compose. Logs: docker compose logs hermes-dashboard
cards.notes: NO HTTP check on purpose — it falls through to the container-state signal. hermes-dashboard runs in caddy's network namespace (network_mode: service:caddy) and binds 127.0.0.1:9119, so it does not resolve on ordo-net and any HTTP probe could ONLY fail; the container's own healthcheck curls 127.0.0.1:9119 inside the namespace and is the truer signal. Do not re-add an HTTP check unless it stops being loopback-only. Lifecycle buttons target hermes-dashboard (the UI service), NOT the agent/gateway — its self-restart is delicate and it is not allowlisted.
